node.statement: Choose the constants as follows. From lem-maincb-error-improvement choose, enlarging its coefficient if necessary by lem-maincb-extended-inclusion-monotone, a universal witness c0 >= 1 for which its conclusion remains valid. Fix corresponding witnesses L^0 >= 1 and e_env^0 > 0 from lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope, and then C_cross^0 >= 1 and e_cross^0 > 0 from lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum. Set K_3^0 := max{1,e_cross^0/e_env^0}. These choices are universal and K_3^0 >= 1.
